desc:
🚗💨 Welcome to Friday Night Sends  — the ultimate Aussie cruise, skid and car culture experience on Roblox!

Build your dream ride, hit late-night meets, rip burnouts, drift mountain roads and cruise with mates across a detailed Australian-inspired map. From clean street builds to wild 2000s-style send cars, this is where true car culture comes alive.

🔥 Features:
• Realistic Aussie-inspired cars
• Customisation & upgraded builds
• Car meets, cruises & roleplay
• Skids, drifts & highway pulls
• Chill night-time atmosphere
• More updates coming regularly!

Whether you’re here to cruise clean or send it limiter-first, there’s a spot for everyone.

👍 Leave a like + favourite to support future updates!
🔔 Join the community and stay tuned for new cars, maps and features.

“Built for the culture.” 🇦🇺
